title: No involutions in the missing Moore graph
summary: The existence of a Moore graph of degree $57$ is the last open case in the Hoffman-Singleton classification of Moore graphs of diameter two. We prove that such a graph, if one exists, has no involutory automorphisms; consequently its automorphism group has odd order.
